    • writeAndAssessTopology

      public static Dexpi20ProcessTopologyAssessment.Report writeAndAssessTopology(ProcessSystem processSystem, File file, String plantId, String revision) throws IOException
      Writes a Process exchange and compares supported material topology with the canonical diagram graph.
      Parameters:
      processSystem - source simulation topology
      file - destination DEXPI XML file
      plantId - persistent plant or project identifier used by the canonical graph
      revision - controlled source-model revision
      Returns:
      schema/profile conformance plus structured topology-equivalence and scope evidence
      Throws:
      IOException - if serialization, validation, or assessment fails

    • writeAndAssessTopology

      public static Dexpi20ProcessTopologyAssessment.Report writeAndAssessTopology(ProcessSystem processSystem, File file, String plantId, String revision, String operatingCaseId) throws IOException
      Writes an assessed Process exchange whose operating values come from one canonical case snapshot.

      This opt-in overload does not change the established topology-only overload. Only finite, unit-explicit calculation nodes for operatingCaseId are serialized; missing values are omitted with structured diagnostics and are never read directly from streams as a fallback. Generated values remain calculated, review-required engineering evidence.

      Parameters:
      processSystem - source simulation topology with a successful completed run
      file - destination DEXPI XML file
      plantId - persistent plant or project identifier used by the canonical graph
      revision - controlled source-model revision
      operatingCaseId - stable operating-case identifier
      Returns:
      schema/profile conformance plus topology, value-source, and loss evidence
      Throws:
      IOException - if serialization, validation, or assessment fails
